user.title: Webasto Cool Top Trail
user.description: Pair the bridge using the built-in ESPHome integration first. Select its Received IR frame sensor and send_frame action. Controls wait for a valid remote frame. For a transmitter without a receiver, you may opt into default starting settings: off, cool, 24 °C, auto fan, display on, unlocked, Sleep and timers off. The first explicit command applies that complete profile. IR provides no appliance feedback; room temperature is optional.
